turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Hello,

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Hana.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Good to see you. Let me just confirm. Full name and date of birth.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Hana Kobayashi, July 3, 1997. Thank you.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Last time you mentioned you were thinking about getting a dog.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Did it happen? It did. A little Shiba puppy. She's chewed two pairs of my shoes already. That's the price of admission.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: So, how has your mood been since July?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Honestly, really steady. On my mood chart app most days are a 5 or a 6. No big lows, no highs.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: No stretches of feeling revved up, needing less sleep, spending more than usual.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No, the last time that happened was two years ago, before we found the right dose. And any low periods,

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: losing interest in things, staying in bed.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No, not since last winter, and that was mild.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: How are you sleeping?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: About seven hours, pretty regular. I keep the same bedtime, like you told me.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Good, you're on lamitrogen 200 milligrams once a day, correct.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Yes, well wait, is it 150? No, no, it's 200. The 150 was before the last increase. Right,

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: 200, any missed doses.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Maybe once a month I forget, then I just take it the next day as usual. That's fine, any rash,

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: mouth sores, or blisters anywhere. No, nothing like that.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Anything else you're taking. Just a multivitamin every morning. Oh, and that's actually what I wanted to ask about. My gynaecologist, Dr. Alvarez, wants to start me on birth control pills next month. The combination one, norgestimate and ethanol estradiol.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: I'm glad you asked, that's important. The estrogen in combination pills can lower lamitrogen levels in your blood, sometimes by about half, so the dose that works now could stop being enough.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Oh, I didn't know that.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Most people don't, before we talk plans, any thoughts of suicide or of hurting yourself.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No, none. I still have my safety plan and 988 saved in my phone.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Good and I looked at your lab work from your primary care doctor in August. Your liver and kidney tests were all normal. Your blood pressure today is 112 over 70 and your weight is 131 same as last time. You're bright and relaxed today, mood euthemic, speech is normal, not pressured, and your thoughts are organized.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: My brother takes lamatrogen for his seizures, actually, he never mentioned this.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: It applies to anyone on it, so to sum up, your bipolar roman 2 disorder is stable on lamatrogen 200 milligrams a day, and we'll keep that dose for now. Here's the plan for the pill. I'd like a baseline lamatrogen level this week, drawn in the morning before your dose at our lab at 2200 Kessler Boulevard. Then once you start the pill, we'll recheck the level two to three weeks later, and I'll probably need to increase your dose.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Okay, and if I didn't want to deal with that.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: A Progestin -only option or an IUD wouldn't really affect it. That's worth raising with Dr. Alvarez. Either way is fine with me, just keep me in the loop.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I'll talk to her.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Two safety reminders.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: If you ever get a rash,

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: especially with fever or mouth sores, stop the lamitrogen and call us or go to the emergency room. And if you miss five days or more in a row, don't restart at 200, call us, because we need to build back up slowly.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Got it. Keep the multivitamin.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: I'll see you in three months, unless the level or the pill changes things sooner. Is 317 -555 -0172 still the best number for the lab results?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Yep, same number. Thanks, Dr. Petrenko.
